blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google: Thanks, Jim.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Hi, everyone. Thanks for joining us. It was a tremendous quarter for Alphabet. The launch of Gemini 3 was a major milestone and we have great momentum.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Alphabet annual revenues exceeded $400 billion for the first time. This quarter, Search continued to accelerate with revenues growing 17%. YouTube’s annual revenues surpassed $60 billion across Ads and Subscriptions.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Cloud significantly accelerated with revenues growing 48%, now on an annual run rate of over $70 billion. Backlog grew by 55% quarter-over-quarter to $240 billion, representing a wide breadth of customers, driven by demand for AI products.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: We have over 325 million paid subscriptions across consumer services, with strong adoption for Google One and YouTube Premium. In addition, we have sold more than 8 million paid seats of Gemini Enterprise, which we launched just four months ago.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: And our Gemini App now has over 750 million monthly active users. We’re also seeing significantly higher engagement per user, especially since the launch of Gemini 3 in December.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Overall, we’re seeing our AI investments and infrastructure drive revenue and growth across the board. To meet customer demand and capitalize on the growing opportunities ahead of us, our 2026 CapEx investments are anticipated to be in the range of $175 billion to $185 billion.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Today, I’ll provide an update on our AI progress and then share highlights from Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Waymo.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: First, AI progress across the full stack.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Our unrivaled infrastructure serves as the bedrock of our AI stack. We have the industry’s widest variety of compute options. That includes GPUs from our partner NVIDIA, who announced at CES that we’ll be among the first to offer their latest Vera Rubin GPU platform. Plus, our own TPUs that we’ve been developing for a decade.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: In December, we announced our intent to acquire Intersect, which provides data center and energy infrastructure solutions.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: As we scale, we’re getting dramatically more efficient. We were able to lower Gemini serving unit costs by 78% over 2025 through model optimizations, efficiency and utilization improvements.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Next, world-class AI research, including models and tooling.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: We offer the most extensive model portfolio in the world and lead across Text, Vision, and Image-to-Video LMArena leaderboards.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Gemini 3 Pro drives the state of the art in reasoning and multimodal understanding. It has seen the fastest adoption of any model in our history. Since launch, Gemini 3 Pro has consistently processed 3x as many daily tokens on average as 2.5 Pro.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Our latest model powers Google Antigravity, our new development platform where agents can autonomously plan and execute complex software tasks. It already has more than 1.5 million weekly active users after launching just over two months ago.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Our first-party models, like Gemini, now process over 10 billion tokens per minute via direct API use by our customers, up from 7 billion last quarter.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Third, bringing AI to our products and platforms.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: We’re shipping innovation at scale to bring helpful AI features to people everywhere. In January alone, we have launched Personal Intelligence in AI Mode in Search and the Gemini App; introduced new AI features to Gmail and updated Veo; reimagined Chrome as an AI-first, agentic browser through features like Chrome Auto Browse; announced Project Genie, which lets users create and explore interactive worlds generated in real-time using Genie 3, our general-purpose world model.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: And we laid the groundwork for shopping in the AI era by introducing a new open standard for agentic commerce, the Universal Commerce Protocol, built alongside many retail industry leaders.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Finally, from Android to Pixel, we're getting our best AI capabilities into people's hands. At CES, a range of partners, including Samsung, showcased how they're bringing Gemini to more devices, from XR to the living room and beyond.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: And to confirm the rumors, we'll be introducing our Pixel 10a to our best-ever rated Pixel 10 series very soon.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Turning now to key highlights from the quarter, starting with Search. Search saw more usage in Q4 than ever before, as AI continues to drive an expansionary moment.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: We’ve executed with incredible speed. We shipped over 250 product launches within AI Mode and AI Overviews just last quarter.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: We’ve integrated Gemini 3 directly into AI Mode in Search. Now Search can better understand your query, dive deeper on the web, and generate interactive UI experiences.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: And last week, we upgraded AI Overviews to Gemini 3, giving users a best-in-class AI response at the top of the Search results page.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: We’ve also made the Search experience more cohesive, ensuring the transition from an AI Overview to a conversation in AI Mode is completely seamless.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: These new experiences are proving to be more helpful and are driving greater usage.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: A few highlights: first, once people start using these new experiences, they use them more. In the U.S., we saw daily AI Mode queries per user double since launch and AI Overviews continue to perform very well.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Second, people are engaging in longer, more complex sessions. Queries in AI Mode are 3x longer than traditional searches. We are also seeing sessions become more conversational, with a significant portion of queries in AI Mode now leading to a follow-up question.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Third, people are searching in new ways beyond text. Nearly one in six AI Mode queries are now non-text, using voice or images. And Circle to Search is now available on over 580 million Android devices.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Next, Google Cloud.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Our growth in revenue, operating margin and backlog highlights the strength of our entire portfolio.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: One, we are winning more new customers faster. We exited the year with double the new customer velocity compared to Q1.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Two, we are also signing larger customer commitments. The number of deals in 2025 over $1 billion surpassed the previous three years combined.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: And three, we continue to deepen our relationships with existing customers, who are outpacing their initial commitments by over 30%.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Nearly 75% of Google Cloud customers have used our vertically optimized AI, from chips, to models, to AI platforms, and enterprise AI agents which offer superior performance, quality, security, and cost-efficiency. These AI customers use 1.8x as many products as those who do not, enabling us to diversify our product portfolio, deepen customer relationships and accelerate revenue growth.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Our product line has multiple monetization levers, spanning infrastructure, platform, and high-margin, AI-powered products and services with 14 product lines each exceeding $1 billion in annual revenue.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: We offer leading infrastructure for AI training and inference to our Cloud customers, with the industry’s widest variety of compute options: from our own seventh-generation Ironwood TPU to the latest NVIDIA GPUs. Our ten-year track record in building our own accelerators—with expertise in chips, systems, networking, and software—translates to leading power and performance efficiency for large-scale inference and training.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Our Cloud AI accelerators serve the leading frontier AI labs, capital markets firms like Citadel Securities, enterprises like Mercedes-Benz, and governments for high-performance computing applications.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: We also offer our leading generative AI models, including Gemini, Imagen, Veo, Chirp, and Lyria to Cloud customers. In December alone, nearly 350 customers each processed more than 100 billion tokens. In Q4, revenue from products built on our generative AI models grew nearly 400% year-over-year, significantly accelerating from the prior quarter. Today, more than 120,000 enterprises use Gemini, including AI unicorns like Lovable and OpenEvidence, and global enterprises like Airbus and Honeywell. 95% of the top 20, and over 80% of the top hundred SaaS companies use Gemini, including Salesforce and Shopify. Gemini is becoming the AI engine for the world's most successful software companies.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Leading enterprises are also driving strong demand for our enterprise AI agents. We have sold more than 8 million paid seats of Gemini Enterprise, our enterprise AI platform, to more than 2,800 companies, including BNY and Virgin Voyages, to streamline knowledge management and automate processes. Gemini Enterprise managed over five billion customer interactions in Q4, growing 65% year-over-year, for customers including Wendy’s, Kroger, and Woolworths Group.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Our integration of Gemini in Google Workspace is driving wins with global brands like Schwarz Group and public sector organizations like the U.S. Department of Transportation.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: We are also seeing momentum with independent software vendors. Revenue from AI solutions built by our partners increased nearly 300% year-over-year, and commitments from our top 15 software partners grew more than 16x year-over-year.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Before moving on, I’m pleased that we are collaborating with Apple as their preferred Cloud provider and to develop the next generation of Apple Foundation Models, based on Gemini technology.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Up next, YouTube. I want to highlight four points.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: First, streaming. In the living room, YouTube continues to be the number one streamer in the U.S. for nearly three years, according to Nielsen. From the NFL to Coachella,

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: YouTube is where people watch today's biggest popular culture moments unfold.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Second, Subscriptions. We continue to see strong subscription revenue growth across YouTube, particularly YouTube Music Premium. We’ll soon launch new YouTube TV plans, bringing more choice and flexibility to subscribers with over ten genre-specific packages.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: And the NFL has seen strong NFL Sunday Ticket subscriber growth with YouTube, with the highest paid subscriber number ever in the history of the product.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Third, podcasts. To illustrate YouTube’s popularity, in October 2025, viewers watched over 700 million hours of podcasts on Living Room devices, up 75% from just a year prior.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: And fourth, AI is transforming the YouTube experience for both creators and viewers. On average, every day in December, over 1 million channels used our new AI creation tools to supercharge their creativity. During that same month, more than 20 million viewers used our new Ask tool, powered by Gemini, to learn more about the content they watched.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: And finally, Waymo. This week, Waymo raised its largest investment round to date, and is well positioned to continue its momentum, with safety at the core.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: In December, we surpassed 20 million fully autonomous trips and are now providing more than 400,000 rides every week.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Waymo continues to expand its service territory. Its sixth market, Miami, launched two weeks ago; and Waymo will soon expand its service to multiple cities across the U.S., and in the U.K., and Japan.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: The team has made incredible progress on important capabilities, including opening up public service to airports and freeways.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: In closing, 2025 was a fantastic year for the company. A big thanks to our employees and partners worldwide. We’re really well positioned going into 2026.

blocks.speaker: Sundar Pichai, CEO, Alphabet and Google
blocks.text: Now, over to Philipp.
